title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling developers to easily access and process user input in their applications. It will provide a simple and intuitive API for parsing request bodies, supporting common formats such as JSON and URL-encoded data. By adding this feature, yantraverse will become more versatile and user-friendly
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when the framework can successfully parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, and error handling is implemented for invalid or malformed requests
reason: Adding request body parsing will significantly improve the framework's usability and make it more competitive with other Node.js frameworks
